description: This file defines an abstract class SynthUnit for a MIDI synthesizer, providing a method to convert MIDI pitch to frequency and a placeholder for rendering sound.

classes.name: SynthUnit
classes.description: An abstract base class for synthesizer units, including pitch-to-frequency conversion and rendering functionalities.

methods.name: pitchToFrequency
methods.description: Converts a MIDI pitch value in semitones to its corresponding frequency in Hz.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Abstract method to produce audio output; to be implemented by subclasses.
